highlights: Green Lion Kids Smart Watch Series-1
The Green Lion Kids Smart Watch is a cutting-edge wearable designed to keep children connected and safe.
The 1.44” HD display screen is vibrant and easily navigable, making it engaging for kids. Essential communication is made seamless through two-way calling, enabled by the 2G network.
For young photographers, the smartwatch features an HD camera, allowing them to capture their adventures in high definition.
The location and trace features are pivotal for parents to keep track of their children’s whereabouts, ensuring their safety.
With a battery capacity of 400mAh, the watch boasts an impressive standby time of 5 days, while the 32MB RAM ensures smooth performance.
The Green Lion Kids Smart Watch is an amalgamation of fun, safety, and technology for the young generation.
